title: SoftBank becomes lead equity funder of Stargate

sources.quote: SoftBank and OpenAI are the lead partners for Stargate, with SoftBank having financial responsibility and OpenAI having operational responsibility.

explain: Stargate is a new company that planned to invest $500 billion over four years in AI data centers for OpenAI, starting with $100 billion. SoftBank is a lead equity funder with financial responsibility, but its own dollar share was not disclosed.
